structured_output.rationale: 835 shows claim-level denial: CO-16 with MOA N286 on all lines. N286 = missing/invalid referring provider. The 837P has no ordering/referring provider loop (NM1*DN/DQ). Medicare Part B requires it. Eligibility active (EB*1). Fix: add referring provider NPI and resubmit as new original (CLM05-3=1).

root_cause.explanation: Claim billed without an ordering/referring provider NPI. 835 carries CO-16 + N286 at claim level; all four lines denied $0.

next_action.detail: Add the referring/ordering provider name and NPI (verify in PECOS). Resubmit as a new original claim (CLM05-3=1). Do not use frequency 7 on Medicare Part B.

evidence.fact: MOA***N286 at claim level; all lines CAS*CO*16 with $0 paid
No NM1*DN or NM1*DQ (referring/ordering provider) loop present in the claim
CLP*PA28755879*4 — claim status 4 (denied); payer claim number 2626660924906 confirms adjudication
